CVE-2026-132998.title: libeot: libeot: heap buffer overflow in the MTX (MicroType Express) decompressor
CVE-2026-132998.description: A heap buffer overflow was found in libeot, a library that converts Embedded OpenType (EOT) fonts. Processing a specially crafted font file can cause the decompressor to write beyond the end of an allocated buffer, resulting in a crash or possible memory corruption.

CVE-2026-132999.title: libeot: libeot: use-after-free in parseCTF
CVE-2026-132999.description: A use-after-free was found in libeot, a library that converts Embedded OpenType (EOT) fonts. Processing a specially crafted font file can cause the library to access memory after it has been freed, resulting in a crash or possible memory corruption.
